workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when both of them are free (need 30 min slot):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these time slots and let me know which ones work for both of them? Thanks!

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against all the candidate slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots work for both Elena and David:

- Monday 09:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both are busy 13:00-14:00
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both are busy 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy the entire slot (15:00-16:00)
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both are busy 11:00-12:00

There is no overlapping availability across all four partners in any of the slots where Priya and Marcus are both free. We may need to report this as infeasible or flag for human intervention. What do you recommend?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Thanks for checking, Brad. That's surprising that none of the slots work. Before we report infeasible, could you provide the complete list of times when BOTH Elena and David are free next week? That way I can do a full cross-reference with Priya and Marcus's calendars to make absolutely sure we haven't missed anything. Also, please double-check your analysis - it's unusual for there to be zero overlap across all six candidate slots.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've done a careful re-check of both Elena and David's calendars. Here are all the times when BOTH Elena and David are free next week:

- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 13:30-14:00, 14:30-16:00

Now cross-referencing with Priya and Marcus's free times that you provided:
- Monday: Priya/Marcus free 09:00-10:00 vs Elena/David free 11:00-12:00 → NO overlap
- Tuesday: Priya/Marcus free 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00 vs Elena/David free 09:00-10:00 → NO overlap
- Wednesday: Priya/Marcus free 15:00-16:00 vs Elena/David free 13:00-14:00 → NO overlap
- Thursday: Priya/Marcus free 10:00-10:30 vs Elena/David free 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30 → NO overlap (09:30-10:00 ends exactly when 10:00-10:30 starts, no shared time)
- Friday: Priya/Marcus free 11:00-12:00 vs Elena/David free 13:30-14:00, 14:30-16:00 → NO overlap

There is genuinely no time next week when all four partners are free for a 30-minute meeting. This appears to be a true infeasibility situation. I recommend we use report_infeasible to end the task.
